cases.title: Antimagic outside→inside geometry and immutable dispel-operation snapshot
cases.currentInitialState: Field F1 center(0,0), radius10. Wizard9 W1 stands at(20,0), RP30. Medium B center(7.5,0), footprint x[5,10],y[-2.5,2.5], intersects F1. Medium A center(15,0), footprint x[12.5,17.5],y[-2.5,2.5], wholly outside F1. W1 faces west. B already carries a live rank5 Spell Resistance application. Separate field F2 center(15,0),radius10 is independently active, so B is also within F2. Wizard9 W2 at(20,10), RP30, can place Greater Dispel center(5,0) within30ft/LoE and capture F1,F2 and B's Spell Resistance.
actionsAndResolution: T0 W1 casts actual Burning Hands: Action/V/S/F, rank1, base2RP, RP30→28. This is W1's first named cast in the fixture: ordinary Dissonance +1, Refrain +0. The 15-ft west-facing cone from(20,0) legally intersects A and B; both fail DEX. Roll3d6=10. A is outside all Antimagic and takes10 fire. B's recipient body intersects F1/F2, so AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 suppresses the local instantaneous damage manifestation: B receives no packet/root.

On W1's later legal Action, W1 casts Dimensional Door: Action/V/S/F, rank4, 7RP, RP28→21. Different spell name gives Refrain +0 and ordinary rank1-5 Dissonance +1. Destination footprint is centered(0,0) inside F1, so the paid relocation fails atomically at origin with no delayed release.
On W2's legal Action, W2 casts Greater Dispel: Action/V/S/F,10RP, RP30→20, center(5,0), radius30. Capture set is immutable before removal: F1, F2, and B's rank5 Spell Resistance application.

Before any termination, AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 snapshots suppression for each captured operation. F1's termination ignores F1 itself but F2 covers the F1 application locus at(0,0), so F1 termination is suppressed. F2's termination ignores F2 itself but F1 covers F2's locus at(15,0)? No: distance15>10, so F1 does not suppress F2's termination; rank5 therefore ends automatically. Spell Resistance termination at B is suppressed by both fields in the operation snapshot.

Execute the snapshot: F1 remains; F2 ends; Spell Resistance remains because its already-snapshotted termination operation was suppressed. Do not rescan/retry Spell Resistance merely because F2 ended. F1 continues under its own deadline.

A.fieldRelation: outside F1; inside/at F2 center but Burning Hands test concerns incoming F1 suppression

cases.currentAdjudication: Incoming payload geometry is legal, and Greater Dispel termination suppression is classified once per captured operation before removals. Self-dispel ignores only the targeted field itself; another field may suppress that operation; suppressed sibling operations do not spring back after an earlier field ends.
notes: Greater Dispel procedure is authored AC5 procedure; its source card has no complete operational block.
